name: supine-hip-internal-rotation
instructions:
1. In a supine position, keep the head relaxed, feet flat, knees up, and arms out to the side.
2. Use a slightly wider than shoulder width stance and exhale while trying to drive the knees together.
3. If you can touch the knees, slightly widen your stance and repeat the process until your knees can just barely touch.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
